properties.site-address: Welwyn Electronics Park Site B, Bedlington
properties.notes: Existing employment site but identified as having potential for redevelopment following clearance, perhaps alongside adjacent land (site 5094) as part of a wider scheme. However, the site is occupied by a range of industrial buildings and operating businesses so would not be immediately available for redevelopment. The indicative yield highlighted recognises the potential for development at slightly higher density in keeping with the location.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
